terms_note: Not live-verified: built from OpenRouter's image generation page (read 2026-11-02), no recorded call. OpenRouter now has a dedicated POST /api/v1/images endpoint, so chat completions with modalities are not used. Prices are per endpoint and change. Only one price is published in the docs, so other models report an unknown estimate and the response's usage.cost settles the real figure. Failed generations are documented as not billed. The rights of each output depend on the model behind it. Check Paradox's and Steam's rules for AI-generated mod assets before publishing.
